key_findings: Oral crotalphine analgesia in PSNL mice requires spinal CB1/CB2, mu/kappa/delta opioid receptors, endogenous opioid peptides and microglia.
Crotalphine lowers spinal IL-6 and polarizes BV-2 microglia from M1 (CD86) to M2 (CD206).
